descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity The SHE Manager will lead, manage, and develop the local Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) and its operational activities within the affiliate. This role is crucial for embedding corporate and local SHE standards, driving regulatory compliance, and minimizing organizational risk through proactive leadership and continuous improvement. Main
• Responsibilities - Management Advisory & Culture: Partner with senior and line management to provide expert safety guidance and actively promote local and global Roche SHE objectives across the company. - Compliance & Gap Resolution: Support the organization in meeting local legal regulations and Roche provisions by performing gap analyses, maintaining the SHE handbook, and ensuring all required legal permits are secured. - Risk Mitigation & Inspections: Implement and document formal risk analyses, conduct periodic workplace safety inspections, and maintain a robust business continuity plan. - Data Monitoring & Incident Reporting: Track and document key safety metrics, including employee training, incidents/injuries, environmental emissions, resource usage, and overall progress toward SHE goals. - Emergency Readiness & External Relations: Establish internal emergency management systems, advise external crisis teams during incidents, and maintain professional contacts with local authorities and the public. Who you are? Required Education and Experience - University Degree (License) in SHE or Engineering, Masters degree in SHE is preferred. - At least 2 years of professional experience in the SHE field. - Professional fluency in three languages: English, French, and Arabic. Required Competencies and Skills - Strategic & Operational Leadership: Self-directed ability to develop and implement strategic EHS plans; acts with a positive, proactive energy, a sense of urgency, and enthusiasm even in difficult situations. - Workload & Stress Management: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of prioritizing a complex, varied workload to deliver thorough work under pressure and tight deadlines. - Communication & Collaboration: Superior verbal and written communication skills across all levels of the organization, with the ability to explain complex requirements clearly, listen excellently, and work seamlessly within cross-functional teams. - Problem-Solving & Analytics: Strong technical capabilities in software use, paired with sharp problem-solving, judgment, and decisive decision-making skills. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
